finding: Hosted web Jobs reset Search jobs=design, Job location=Remote and Freelance on Home then Jobs navigation, and replaced previously loaded content with Loading jobs.
changes: Jobs restores search, location, category, sort, loaded rows, saved IDs, city and scroll synchronously from the existing browser navigation session cache.
Loaded empty results also restore without an initial loading replacement. Background failures keep usable rows and filter state with an in-place retry.
The loader coalesces foreground triggers, bounds and cancels work, pins the captured authorization on three parallel reads, and rejects stale session/account results including A to B to A.
Unused poster-profile enrichment was removed; JobCard never rendered those fields.
A successful save or unsave updates the remembered Discover bookmark from other Jobs routes. Newer confirmed saves override older in-flight reads; unmount cleanup cannot overwrite the confirmation.
Expired deadline rows are filtered from restored results.
Updated the existing Jobs parity hook harness to render the account-scoped wrapper and supply the real navigation-store interface; its cold-error assertions remain intact.
Confirmed saves send an owner/session-scoped event so a replacement Jobs instance can fence its already-running older saved-IDs read.
Every confirmation advances mutation ordering even when its boolean equals current state; an unchanged Set is reused to avoid a redundant render.

Job mutations capture the current Auth token, verify the component/session before constructing the query, pin Authorization, abort on session changes including same-owner new logins and A to B to A, and fence acknowledgement by original scope.

Authentication and mutation waits each have the existing 12-second deadline and no automatic retry. An already-issued same-session mutation may finish across route unmount; work still waiting for Auth may not start after unmount.

jobsCases.name: warm Jobs return retains the exact search/location/category/sort, eight loaded rows and scroll on every observed destination frame
confirmed save survives a background response captured before the mutation
unsaving on the real shortlist updates the remembered Discover bookmark before its refresh completes
an already-dispatched same-session save confirms after route remount and fences the replacement screen older shortlist read
failed warm refresh retains filtered rows and in-place retry recovers
A to B to A clears prior filters/results and aborts old reads and a pending save before new-session data renders
a previously loaded empty Jobs dataset retains filters and its empty state on warm return

scopeAndLimits: Actual JobsPage, JobCard and SavedJobsPage in Chromium with synthetic Auth/database and Next routing. The fixture Home destination is a placeholder.
The loaded fixture contains 14 jobs, eight matching design + Remote + Freelance. A separate phase verifies a successfully loaded empty dataset, matching the live QA data condition.

Frames are sampled after the Jobs component is present; they establish filter, row and scroll continuity during held refreshes. They do not measure the hosted sibling-layout/root-loading transition, RSC latency or GPU paint time.
No job, application, live saved item or other record was created or changed outside the synthetic fixture.
Native source and music licensing configuration were not changed by this follow-up.

independentReview.method: Separate read-only source review, pre-fix actual-component browser reproduction and installed-SDK synthetic fetch reproduction. No hosted traffic.
findingsResolved: Save confirmation from the unmounted previous Jobs instance could be overwritten by the replacement instance stale shortlist read.
SDK implicit Authorization can rebind to a new same-user session across A to B to A.
Repeated same-value confirmation must advance ordering even when current membership already matches.
